name: json2dir-F-
description: The whole CLI written in F* and extracted to OCaml; Lean spec theorems ported as F* lemmas checked with Z3
build:
# F* v2026.09.27 release (bundles z3) + OCaml 5.3.0 opam switch (findlib, batteries, stdint, zarith, ppx_deriving, ppx_deriving_yojson); env.sh sets OPAMROOT/FSTAR_HOME. `make` runs F* verification, extraction and ocamlopt.
. {runtimes}/opam-fstar/env.sh && make
